baseline_problem: Manual feasibility work constrained a two-person architecture firm and risked exceeding the fee
intervention: Used TestFit to generate and compare site/programming options with live financial data
measured_outcome: 160 hours saved per feasibility study; study completed in 3 weeks; stayed within target fee
period_sample_denominator: One Logan Street feasibility study; exact labor baseline not disclosed.
causal_caveat: Self-reported estimate; no independent time study or control.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX early site screening if local parcel/zoning/cost data are available; validate with pilot.

baseline_problem: Multifamily site plans took at least 3 days and consumed non-billable marketing labor
intervention: Automated site planning and 2D/3D iteration with TestFit
measured_outcome: Plan reduced from 3 days to half a day; more than $200,000 saved in non-billable hours in first year
period_sample_denominator: First year; denominator is company estimate and number of studies not disclosed.
causal_caveat: Attribution and fee calculation are not independently audited; selection effects possible.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX land screening and concept studies; use time logs and separate feasibility from design authority.

baseline_problem: Manual site evaluation using maps, GIS and calls took up to one week per study
intervention: Used TestFit for self-storage site evaluation and preliminary layouts
measured_outcome: Turnaround fell from one week to 2 hours (reported 20x faster); annual jobs increased from 100 to 400; 280+ studies completed
period_sample_denominator: Since adoption; study count is cumulative and jobs are annual; causal denominator not published.
causal_caveat: Company attributes output growth to tool but demand/staffing may also contribute.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: Medium-high for JCX repeatable screening; local regulations and cadastral coverage must be proven.

baseline_problem: Affordable housing/site optimization,Spreadsheet and SketchUp modeling made 10 prototype analyses costly and less precise
intervention: Used generative building/site models with real-time quantity and financial data
measured_outcome: Feasible housing price reduced 28% while fitting 2x more units per acre; prior modeling cost was 20 hours/$6,000 for 10 prototypes
period_sample_denominator: City of Lebanon, Oregon analysis; outcome is modeled feasibility, not delivered project.
causal_caveat: Model output is not a realized development result; assumptions and zoning context are local.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: Medium for JCX scenario modeling; must adapt costs, FAR, setbacks, parking, flood and approvals.

baseline_problem: International bridge design relied on traditional drawings and fragmented expert workflows
intervention: Connected five Autodesk APIs in a central environment for model visualization, project management and automation
measured_outcome: 99.5% reduction in traditional drawings; design-to-preconstruction under 2 years; 3% reduction in total hours; 60 million data points connected
period_sample_denominator: Sotra Bridge; experts in 45 countries/3 continents; denominator is project process not a control group.
causal_caveat: Results blend digital process and project complexity; hours outcome lacks pre-period comparison.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High strategic relevance: a common data environment and APIs can connect JCX design/construction/operations.

baseline_problem: Hospital teams expected about 200 hours of annual site rework from design changes and paper redlines
intervention: Used a shared model/CDE and digital redlines in Autodesk Construction Cloud
measured_outcome: Estimated rework fell to 10-20 hours from usual 200 hours; redline time cut in half
period_sample_denominator: One hospital build; one-year expected comparison, no independent audit.
causal_caveat: Estimate is retrospective and not externally verified; avoided rework may not be fully observed.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX: shared drawings, approval history and issue logs are practical first digitization wins.

baseline_problem: Complex semiconductor project faced clashes, rework, slow approvals and handover discontinuity
intervention: Combined 4D BIM, LiDAR, photogrammetry, cloud RFIs/issues and Bridge data continuity
measured_outcome: 60% fewer clashes; 20% less rework; 30% efficiency improvement; some approvals from 5 days to 1 day or hours; handovers saved months
period_sample_denominator: Semiconductor facility project; exact period and denominator not disclosed.
causal_caveat: Marketing-reported project estimate; outcomes may overlap and are not independently audited.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX flagship developments, but sensor/model standards and subcontractor adoption are prerequisites.

baseline_problem: Teams spent excessive time transferring models and reviewing floors through disconnected workflows
intervention: Adopted Autodesk Construction Cloud as CDE on Keppel South Central and subsequent projects
measured_outcome: 432 work hours saved per week; 32.5% productivity gain; model transfer time cut 32.5%; floor review time cut by half
period_sample_denominator: First fully used project began 2021; weekly estimate; 40-hour workweek equivalence stated by source.
source_type: Vendor customer story; customer management report
causal_caveat: Company-reported estimate; productivity definition and allocation of 432 hours are not independently validated.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX if role-based workflows and reliable internet/mobile access are designed.

baseline_problem: Design coordination used email/download cycles and threatened a tight bid deadline
intervention: Used BIM Collaborate Pro, shared model and 360-degree site model/AR verification
measured_outcome: More than 1,000 design hours saved; file-transfer lag reduced 80%; bid deadline met
period_sample_denominator: Collins Park project; project-level result; period not disclosed.
causal_caveat: Customer estimate and no control group; deadline and hours may include workflow changes beyond software.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX multi-party projects where consultant/contractor changes need one audit trail.

baseline_problem: Laborious quantity takeoff and variance reporting,Teams compared drawing versions manually and exported Revit data into spreadsheets
intervention: Implemented model-based quantity takeoff and cloud construction data management
measured_outcome: 40% reduction in quantity takeoff time; 70% reduction in variance-report time; 40% reduction in trending-report time
period_sample_denominator: Company process comparison; sample/project count not disclosed.
causal_caveat: No independent audit or absolute hours; results may reflect process standardization as well as software.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX BOQ, tender comparison and variation-control workflows; test with one project.

baseline_problem: Manual quality checks risked concrete-floor errors and expensive rework
intervention: Used connected progressive scanning to verify cast-in-place floor work at One River North Residences
measured_outcome: Measured 1,164% ROI; 31.2%/144 tCO2e GHG savings otherwise associated with rework materials
period_sample_denominator: One residential project; ROI calculation combines labor and estimated avoided correction costs.
causal_caveat: Strong quantified accounting but modeled avoided rework is counterfactual and vendor/partner supported.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: Medium-high for JCX high-value structural work; camera/scanner procurement and skilled QA are needed.

baseline_problem: Multi-fab projects had 50,000+ activities and thousands of workers with manual progress tracking and installation deviations
intervention: Used Buildots computer vision and model updates to compare site reality with plan
measured_outcome: 4.3% rework cost saved per fab; 4 construction weeks of delay avoided per fab; 1,176 model updates per fab
period_sample_denominator: Multiple fab projects; source page headline elsewhere says 6 weeks, detailed result says 4 weeks; flag discrepancy.
causal_caveat: Vendor-reported estimated savings; rework baseline and causal calculation not published; source has headline inconsistency.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: Medium-high for JCX large projects if BIM models, capture cadence and QA governance exist.

baseline_problem: Project managers relied on subjective/manual progress reporting and had poor visibility into trade performance and delays
intervention: Piloted AI progress tracking and expanded from one project to four
measured_outcome: 2.3x more tasks completed on time; 70% reduction in manual reporting; tracked area reached 68,500 sqm; thousands of euros in avoided disputes
period_sample_denominator: Pilot plus three additional projects; outcome denominator and baseline not fully disclosed.
causal_caveat: Reported comparison metric is not accompanied by raw counts or independent verification.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: Medium-high for JCX contractor dashboards; begin with percent-plan-complete and capture governance.

baseline_problem: Weekly site documentation took a minimum of four hours per user and did not create a reliable history for disputes/closeout
intervention: Deployed 360-degree reality capture across projects after a three-month pilot
measured_outcome: More than 6,000 documentation hours saved annually; faster dispute resolution and billing verification reported
period_sample_denominator: Portfolio-scale estimate; source cites 60% healthcare business and annual hours, but user count not disclosed.
causal_caveat: Annual estimate is self-reported and aggregates multiple projects; no independent time study.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX: timestamped site records can support progress claims, handover and dispute resolution.

baseline_problem: Reality capture and change-order prevention,Smartphone progress photos were slower, incomplete and required manual upload/mapping; a change order was disputed
intervention: Used hard-hat 360 capture and searchable ground-truth records
measured_outcome: Documentation 30x faster than prior smartphone capture; nearly half a workday saved weekly; stopped a $50,000 potential change order; 10x more images/week
period_sample_denominator: One project/team; outcome is customer estimate and avoided-cost counterfactual.
causal_caveat: Counterfactual avoided cost and time are not externally verified; project context may be unusually favorable.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX construction documentation and post-handover evidence; validate camera connectivity and storage.

baseline_problem: Reality capture and remote coordination,Site capture/upload/mapping consumed labor and remote stakeholders traveled to projects
intervention: Automated mapping of frequent 360 imagery with OpenSpace
measured_outcome: 100x more images; capture/upload/mapping labor reduced 95%; 5 hours travel saved per week
period_sample_denominator: Customer project; exact area/duration not disclosed.
causal_caveat: Percent is customer-reported and “100x” imagery does not prove quality or ROI.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX projects spread across Dhaka and regional sites; define capture standards and retention.

baseline_problem: Previous platform captured 2,135 images in 71.96 hours over five months, limiting progress and quality documentation
intervention: Used automated SLAM mapping and frequent capture on a subsequent project
measured_outcome: 160,474 images captured in 22.29 hours over the same five-month span; capture rate increased roughly 75x
period_sample_denominator: Two projects compared over five months; not same project or controlled conditions.
causal_caveat: Comparison confounds platform, project, crew and capture practices; treat as throughput example only.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: Medium-high for JCX standardization, but camera route/time and image usefulness need local validation.

baseline_problem: Senior staff drove 3-4 hours to remote sites and discovered some BIM discrepancies late
intervention: Used OpenSpace captures and BIM Compare for remote progress/quality review
measured_outcome: Up to 10 hours saved per week; thousands of dollars in rework avoided; designers avoided a school-project flight
period_sample_denominator: Multiple projects; “thousands” has no exact value or denominator.
causal_caveat: Self-reported travel/rework estimates; avoided cost is counterfactual.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX regional project oversight and remote approvals, subject to mobile upload reliability.

baseline_problem: Procurement and workflow automation,Purchase orders required 32 minutes and cost $18.23 each; manual admin and staffing overhead constrained margins
intervention: Centralized Procore procurement, ERP integration and automated workflows
measured_outcome: PO time 32 to 7 minutes; per-order cost $18.23 to $4.73; over $30,000 annual PO savings; $115,000 first-year savings; 4,000+ hours saved
period_sample_denominator: Over 2,000 POs/year; first-year estimate; customer says Procore paid back in 3 months.
causal_caveat: Company estimate; first-year savings may overlap categories and staff-cost assumptions.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX procurement, invoice and ERP integration; price/approval controls need localization.

baseline_problem: Administrative tasks and submittal approvals were slow and communication risked information loss
intervention: Used Procore to centralize project information, RFIs and submittals
measured_outcome: Up to 30% less admin time; submittal approval from 5 days to 2 days (60% reduction)
period_sample_denominator: Customer estimate; project count not disclosed.
causal_caveat: “Up to” estimate and no independent baseline; approval result may be project-specific.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX approval workflows with role-based audit trails and Bengali/English notifications.

baseline_problem: Closeout work was labor-intensive during a labor shortage and required fragmented systems
intervention: Used Procore as a unified project and financial platform
measured_outcome: 50% of closeout time saved, approximately 40 hours per project; improved forecasting from real-time cost/billing/progress data
period_sample_denominator: Per-project estimate; denominator is one project’s prior closeout process.
causal_caveat: Customer estimate and no project sample or independent audit.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX handover, defect lists, asset registers and payment documentation.

baseline_problem: Document and quality workflow consolidation,Multiple disconnected tools caused duplicate work, slow drawing upload and quality/safety administration
intervention: Consolidated workflows in Procore and generated submittals from specifications
measured_outcome: $100,000 annual savings from automated drawing upload; 40 hours saved per submittal register; 25% time savings in quality/safety tools
period_sample_denominator: Company estimate; annual and per-register metrics; sample not disclosed.
causal_caveat: Claims are estimates and may not be additive; no audited financials.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: Medium-high for JCX if projects need standardization across sites and subcontractors.

baseline_problem: Subcontract orders required heavy administration and lacked centralized signing visibility
intervention: Automated subcontract order preparation, tracking and compliance in C-Link
measured_outcome: 85% reduction in order-prep time; 4x orders per day; 100% centralized visibility
period_sample_denominator: Main contractor; revenue £100M+; period and order counts not disclosed.
causal_caveat: Vendor-reported customer metric; no independent time logs.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: Medium-high for JCX procurement; useful reference for Bangladeshi subcontractor onboarding and approval trails.

baseline_problem: Only 15% of purchasing volume was coordinated and most purchasing was manual
intervention: Implemented cloud eProcurement/eSourcing and supplier network
measured_outcome: Frame-agreement purchasing increased 15% to 25%; half of coordinated purchases ordered through IBX
period_sample_denominator: Enterprise case; date 2015; exact spend denominator not disclosed.
source_type: Client story with consulting partner; reported customer result
causal_caveat: Older result and no monetary savings disclosed; adoption may reflect policy as well as platform.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High strategic relevance for JCX: procurement control, supplier compliance and preferred-rate leverage.

baseline_problem: Excel/QuickBooks and manual tenant communication/accounts payable
intervention: Unified property management, resident communications and online workflows in AppFolio
measured_outcome: 75% reduction in manual work; 50% less AP time; 60% less communication time; 330+ units managed
period_sample_denominator: Customer story; current portfolio 330+ units; period not disclosed.
causal_caveat: Self-reported percentages; no hours, controls or independent audit.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX property operations once projects become managed communities; start with service requests, payments and owner reporting.

baseline_problem: Fragmented property management and manual bill entry
intervention: Switched from RealPage to AppFolio with resident portal and online payments
measured_outcome: 98% resident portal adoption; 92% online payment adoption; 4 hours/week saved entering bills
period_sample_denominator: 2,000+ units; period not disclosed.
causal_caveat: Adoption is measurable but time saving is self-reported; outcomes may reflect resident incentives/change management.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX portal design, but payment rails and local compliance need Bangladesh-specific integration.

baseline_problem: Legacy Yardi workflow and slow owner-response process
intervention: Adopted integrated PMS, data and owner communication workflows
measured_outcome: 50-70% less time spent in software; owner inquiries answered 200% faster; 40% growth in 18 months
period_sample_denominator: 2,000+ units; 18-month growth window; causal denominator not disclosed.
causal_caveat: Growth cannot be causally attributed to software alone; time estimate is management opinion.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX unified dashboard and owner service model; separate operational ROI from market growth.

baseline_problem: In-person property tours were constrained by COVID-19 and overseas owners/tenants
intervention: Created Matterport digital twins and virtual tours
measured_outcome: 50% reduction in physical visits; 2x email click-through; 56% of tenants found virtual tours useful
period_sample_denominator: 650 homes managed; period from 2020 rollout; survey denominator for usefulness not disclosed.
causal_caveat: Marketing engagement and visitor reduction do not prove faster sale or higher revenue; selection bias possible.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX project marketing, remote diaspora buyers and inspection records; optimize mobile bandwidth and Bengali/English content.

baseline_problem: Commercial clients needed faster space access, service differentiation and scalable capture
intervention: Enterprise Matterport capture program and digital replicas
measured_outcome: 1,000+ properties digitized in under 12 months; footprint in 21 countries; 53% capture-cost savings via global technician network
period_sample_denominator: 12-month period; cost denominator not disclosed.
causal_caveat: Cost comparison is vendor/customer claim and may reflect network pricing; no leasing conversion metric.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX portfolio inventory, virtual tours and as-built handover; define minimum metadata and ownership rights.

baseline_problem: HVAC operation consumed excessive electricity despite a reasonably efficient mall
intervention: AI HVAC optimization using building controls and historical/occupancy/weather data
measured_outcome: 25% HVAC electricity reduction; 55,513 kWh and 9,159.65 AUD annual bill savings; 54 tCO2e reduction; expansion to 38 buildings
period_sample_denominator: 12-month assessment ending September 2021; one shopping centre; portfolio rollout decision afterward.
causal_caveat: Vendor-calculated result; weather/occupancy normalization and baseline method should be audited.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for hot-humid JCX buildings, but controls compatibility, comfort and sensor calibration are critical.

solution_vendor: BrainBox AI via Trane Autonomous Control
baseline_problem: 120+ facilities required HVAC efficiency and emissions reduction
intervention: Deployed autonomous AI control powered by BrainBox AI
measured_outcome: 1,132 mtCO2e reduced and $329,000 energy cost savings in first 18 months
period_sample_denominator: More than 120 facilities; first 18 months; source is Trane customer story.
causal_caveat: Partner-reported savings; facility mix and counterfactual baseline not published.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: Medium-high for JCX multi-site retail/office portfolio, subject to HVAC controls and utility metering.

baseline_problem: HVAC schedules were not aligned with occupancy/weather and generated energy waste
intervention: Installed AI HVAC optimization integrated with existing systems
measured_outcome: 81,066 kWh saved in five months; 11% of building energy; over CAD 7,600 utility cost; air-handling-unit heating modulation runtime down 35%
period_sample_denominator: October 2021-February 2022; five months; one building.
causal_caveat: Short winter period and vendor-calculated comparison; comfort outcome is asserted but not independently measured.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX pilot: choose one building with interval meters and compare weather-normalized baseline.

baseline_problem: Energy and compliance data were manually entered; teams spent time on meter readings and reporting
intervention: Centralized data, automated compliance and real-time energy monitoring/optimization
measured_outcome: $629,000 energy cost savings to date; 6.2M kWh avoided; portfolio average ENERGY STAR score +25%; certified buildings 10 to 24; 100% regulatory compliance
period_sample_denominator: March 2020-May 2025; portfolio; specific building anomalies saved nearly $5,000 and $6,400.
source_type: Vendor customer case study; customer quote
causal_caveat: Vendor/customer-reported avoided cost; savings attribution and weather normalization not independently verified.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX data backbone, compliance and operational savings; use local utility and carbon factors.

baseline_problem: Fragmented building systems and energy wastage limited net-zero/operations visibility
intervention: Connected building operations, fault detection and energy analytics
measured_outcome: 8% energy wastage reduced within 3 weeks; up to 15% savings potential identified; improved equipment performance and tenant satisfaction reported
period_sample_denominator: Portfolio/building scope and baseline not disclosed; 3-week observation.
causal_caveat: Short window and “potential” not realized savings; no independent measurement.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: Medium-high for JCX flagship buildings; use as pilot hypothesis with submeters and fault logs.

baseline_problem: Property tax assessments required fragmented data research and manual comparison
intervention: Centralized commercial real-estate transaction and property data
measured_outcome: 90% reduction in research time; 50% more tax assessments per year
period_sample_denominator: Assessment practice; period not disclosed; exact assessment count omitted.
causal_caveat: Self-reported efficiency and output; revenue effect not independently measured.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX market intelligence and comparable-data workflows if source provenance is maintained.

baseline_problem: Commercial brokers lacked fast, verified property/off-market intelligence and spent time researching
intervention: Used CoStar data and analytics for broker workflows
measured_outcome: 50% productivity boost reported; off-market insights used to generate leads and close deals faster
period_sample_denominator: JLL Canada case; exact broker/team denominator and period not disclosed.
causal_caveat: Vendor/customer claim and productivity definition not published; no independent causal estimate.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: Medium-high for JCX investment/land pipeline and market comparables, but data acquisition/provenance is the hard part.

baseline_problem: Manual broker/customer interactions and poor lead visibility constrained presales
intervention: Built customer 360, partner app, pipeline dashboards and automated alerts on Salesforce
measured_outcome: 100% increase in presales productivity; conversion 5% to 12% (140% relative increase); escalation rate 100% to 20% (80% reduction)
period_sample_denominator: Company case; before/after rates disclosed, sample and period not disclosed.
causal_caveat: Attribution is self-reported; “productivity” denominator and lead mix changes are unknown.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: Very high for JCX website-to-CRM-to-site-visit workflow; define funnel events and lead ownership from day one.

baseline_problem: Sales, service and property apps were disconnected; PII exposure and unsold inventory were concerns
intervention: Unified sales/service/marketing data with WhatsApp and property-app integrations
measured_outcome: Up to 20% marketing conversion; NPS +60%; 10x productivity uplift; sales +27.8% in 2023; unsold/overhang <10%; PII exposure -90% in six months
period_sample_denominator: Company case; 2023 sales and six-month PII window; portfolio/sample not disclosed.
causal_caveat: Multiple outcomes and attribution are company-reported; market conditions and campaign mix not controlled.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX CRM, buyer service and governance; do not copy “10x” without local event definitions.

baseline_problem: Marketing and sales alignment/lead generation needed a scalable inbound system across 75 offices and 1,000 agents
intervention: Implemented personalized buyer journeys, marketing automation, content and sales alignment in HubSpot
measured_outcome: 114% increase in leads; 24% increase in customers; 100% increase in automated emails
period_sample_denominator: Company story; period not disclosed; office/agent base disclosed.
causal_caveat: Lead/customer changes may reflect campaign/agency effects; no denominator or independent audit.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: Medium-high for JCX digital marketing and lead-routing, with local language/portal and consent adaptation.

baseline_problem: Largely offline project launch and sales process during COVID-19
intervention: Digital-only launch with lead management, virtual meetings and booking workflow
measured_outcome: 10,000+ leads managed; 250+ virtual meetings/day; 300+ bookings in 3 weeks
period_sample_denominator: Three-week launch; denominators for conversion/cost not published.
causal_caveat: Counts are marketing-reported and lack independent funnel verification; pandemic context is unusual.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: High for JCX project launch, virtual sales and booking workflow; integrate inventory/price authority and payment compliance.

baseline_problem: L6 Marketing/sales/L7 Occupancy,Digital mortgage closing,Paper/hybrid mortgage closing was slower, costly and error-prone at scale
intervention: Integrated Snapdocs lender/scheduling/eClosing with title software and notary network
measured_outcome: $6.64M saved in 2021-2022; $519 saved per hybrid file; clear-to-close-to-fund 1.5 days faster; fund-to-purchase 8 days faster; 10-point NPS lift; 2M+ pages avoided
period_sample_denominator: 2022 data; file denominator implied for per-file figure but not total volume; 6,000 review sample for 99% reviews.
causal_caveat: Attribution is vendor/customer reported; NPS and savings may be affected by borrower/product mix; title/legal context differs.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: Medium for JCX home sales and mortgage partners; digital signatures, KYC, title and regulation need local legal review.

baseline_problem: L6 Marketing/sales,Digital mortgage closing,Traditional closings took 1.5-2 hours and suffered signature/data errors across multiple platforms
intervention: Unified digital/hybrid closing workflow in Blend Close
measured_outcome: Average closing time reduced to 45 minutes; each closer handles 85-120 loans/month; post-closing signature errors 0% reported
period_sample_denominator: Company story; 9,000+ employees/1,000 branches; per-closer capacity, period not disclosed.
causal_caveat: Zero-error claim needs scope definition; capacity may reflect staffing/process changes beyond Blend.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: Medium for JCX developer-finance ecosystem; prioritize document orchestration and partner APIs before regulated lending.

baseline_problem: Algorithmic home buying accumulated inventory exposed to price/renovation and operational risk
intervention: Zillow wound down Offers and sold inventory after deciding the model’s volatility/forecasting risk was too high
measured_outcome: $407.9M inventory write-down in 2021; Offers wind-down charges primarily recorded in Homes segment
period_sample_denominator: FY2021 SEC filing; reported accounting amount, not an operational KPI.
causal_caveat: This is a high-confidence accounting fact; it does not prove software alone caused the loss—market, pricing and operating model all mattered.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: Critical JCX guardrail: do not automate land/property acquisition without human underwriting, inventory limits and exit triggers.

baseline_problem: Asset-light branding paired with long fixed lease obligations and rapid expansion created structural mismatch
intervention: Chapter 11 restructuring rationalized leases and capital structure
measured_outcome: Approximately $1.5B debt cancelled/equitized and $1.6B maturities extended in 2023 agreement; later emergence reported more than $4B debt shed and future lease obligations cut in half
period_sample_denominator: 2023 restructuring agreement and 2024 emergence; restructuring figures are company/filing reported.
causal_caveat: Financial restructuring is not a PropTech ROI; macro office demand and lease terms were primary drivers.
transferability_bangladesh_jcx: JCX lesson: technology must improve asset economics and flexibility; never confuse a polished digital layer with sustainable unit economics.
